show.description: A poor janitor, rejected by his girlfriend for being a “loser,” secretly turns out to be the mysterious AI genius “Cyber King” and the lost heir of the powerful Oberoi family. Now, he must rise from humiliation to power while facing betrayal, family politics, and dangerous enemies.
